scope: Original installed XPM HDL, LINK010 and LINK010R1 Tcl, private exact patch and reset-interface inspection. No experiment, synthesis, or native binding qualification.

patch_assessment.finding: Exactly two line replacements, both inside synthesis translate_off. S4 retains reset-busy trigger and next-read-edge timing while requiring empty exactly 1; already-empty is accepted, X/Z is rejected. sleep_chk generate condition gains WAKEUP_TIME>0 so zero-length repetitions are not elaborated; positive legal WAKEUP_TIME=2 behavior is unchanged. Native compiler behavior remains pending.

FIFO rst is now the four-stage synchronous reset synchronizer output on clk_fast, separate from asynchronous interface masking. FIFO busy and cross-domain reset completion handshake remain required. The assertion patch is not a substitute for this RTL contract. Clock-running and no-new-reset-during-busy assumptions must be exercised by R1 TB.

Read-only checker passed. Independent exact replacement, balanced translate-marker scan, outside-block byte comparison and changed-line enumeration also passed. CDC and memory are byte-identical; FIFO changed lines are 1584 and 1590 only.

binding_findings.finding: Empty XPM_LIBRARIES does not disable graph auto-detection; installed exporter merges auto_detect_xpm results with this property. Do not infer zero automatic XPM dependencies from the property alone.

binding_findings.reference: AMD UG900 Verilog Search Order; installed xsim/sim.tcl:2016-2020,2115-2118,2162-2164
binding_findings.finding: Search precedence is uselib, then ordered -L libraries, then parent-unit library, then work. Putting RTL/TB and models in cfo_xpm simplifies the project but does not itself outrank -L xpm. Require cfo_xpm before every xpm search entry and verify actual elaborated modules. MORE_OPTIONS is appended last and is not a reliable prepend mechanism.

Blindly disabling precompiled XPM can inject original vendor HDL into a local xpm library before design sources, potentially putting xpm first. Reject unexpected vendor XPM compilation and duplicate module definitions within one active compile useset.

Installed ini maps xpm globally but has no cfo_xpm entry. Local design libraries are generated under compiled_design_lib/library. Verify the generated cfo_xpm map resolves within this new private simulation work directory, has no conflicting later mapping/reparse escape, and never points into installed/global libraries. An unused xpm mapping/search entry alone is not proof of xpm binding.

Reviewed Tcl excludes official files from simulation and private files from synthesis/implementation. Official files do not explicitly set used_in_implementation=false, so describe them as non-simulation hardware sources or set that flag if strictly synthesis-only is required. File-set CSV is inventory, not actual compile-order/binding proof.

minimal_recommendation: Keep the private three-model library and exact two edits; set default_lib=cfo_xpm and explicit LIBRARY=cfo_xpm for all participating HDL if desired. Preserve useset separation. Do not change installed utilities, global ini, assertion-disable macros, or frozen original sources.

Before native compile, inspect/freeze generated .prj, compile command and xsim.ini: exactly the three expected private XPM files for simulation, no official auto-injected XPM source, and cfo_xpm resolving inside the private simulation directory. Check the actual ordered -L arguments before elaboration.

Before claiming simulation PASS, require compile evidence for the private files and elaboration evidence for cfo_xpm.xpm_fifo_async, cfo_xpm.xpm_fifo_base, cfo_xpm.xpm_fifo_rst, cfo_xpm.xpm_memory_base and instantiated CDC units; reject xpm.* bindings and duplicate-definition warnings. Include glbl compilation/top because XPM CDC simulation references glbl.GSR.

If project auto-injection cannot satisfy these gates, use an explicit private .prj/.ini and xelab command with cfo_xpm first; this is deterministic but a larger wrapper change, not necessary when the project-generated evidence meets all gates.

findings.finding: Positive presence checks do not reject extra official or other same-name XPM sources. Extract all analyzed/compiled xpm_cdc.sv, xpm_memory.sv and xpm_fifo.sv paths and require the exact three private paths.

Missing ini or zero cfo_xpm mappings currently passes all([]); mere directory existence is insufficient. Require one unambiguous explicit cfo_xpm mapping to an existing directory resolved beneath the private simdir.

Default compiled_design_lib is xsim.dir, but simulation.compileDesignLibsToXSimLib=true changes it to xsim_lib. Validate the actual private mapping target rather than hardcoding xsim.dir; no live parameter claim was made.

Existing generated compile command points at cfo_estimator_link_tb_vlog.prj, not xvlog.prj. Read and preserve the actual -prj target. Existing xvlog log format places analyzed absolute file path and library on one line.
